# 2 Baruch Chapter 55 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** Then the angel Ramiel, who oversees true visions, came to me and said:

**2** "Why is your heart disturbed, Baruch? Why are you troubled by what you have seen?"

**3** "If you are troubled by what you heard about the final times, listen also to what has been decreed for you personally."

**4** "You will be kept safe until that time — until the very end of the ages."

**5** I, Baruch, answered him: "Then tell me what this vision means, so that I can understand what I have seen."

**6** The angel Ramiel said to me: "I will explain the vision you have seen, since you have been chosen to receive this."

**7** "So hear the interpretation of the black and bright waters you saw, and you will learn what has been decreed for you in the final times."

**8** "Many things have been told to you, and many things shown to you, because you are righteous and obedient to the fear of the Almighty."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
